name: @markless/vitest-browser
description: Vitest browser-mode provider for Markless components.
//: STILL PRIVATE ON PURPOSE. This name has never existed on npm, and npm cannot attach a trusted publisher to a name that was never published, so it needs a one-time owner-run bootstrap publish first. Everything else about publishing it is already prepared here and is proven on every run by scripts/release/verify-packed-manifests.mjs, which packs this package regardless of the private flag. Flipping private to false is what adds it to the release set.
